usage: 蝙蝠 (bat) is a noun used to identify the flying mammal known for echolocation.
You can use 蝙蝠 in singular or plural contexts without changing its form.
蝙蝠 can appear in sentences describing animals, nature, or Halloween themes.
In casual speech, 蝙蝠 can sometimes be used metaphorically, but primarily it refers to the animal.
